data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Jafarah' which means 'to give' or 'to be generous'. In Islam, Jafurah is a name that symbolizes kindness and generosity towards others. The name Jafurah carries the meaning “Generous, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jafurah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
